name: Sherd: Trapezoidal Fragment from the Shoulder and Neck of a Bottle or Vase
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th cent. - 13th cent.；Guan ware: dark gray stoneware with lightly crackled, light grayish blue glaze on the exterior and with thinly applied, crackled, pale blusih gray glaze on the interior. From the guan kilns near Hangzhou, Zhejiang province.
